en: Monochrome vintage view of a fast‑flowing river or rapids in the foreground, with rocky banks and forested hills. On the right, a tall multi‑story building stands prominently on the cliffside. Further back on the ridge, a church with a slender spire rises above the trees. The overall print style and wide blank margin at the bottom suggest an early 20th‑century postcard. No printed caption or text is visible on the front.
